scripts.start: bun run prepare:electrobun && vite build && electrobun dev
scripts.dev:hmr: bun run prepare:electrobun && concurrently "vite --port 5173" "vite build && electrobun dev"
scripts.build:view: bun run prepare:electrobun && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 vite build
scripts.build:canary: bun run build:view && ELECTROBUN_APP_STARTER_DESKTOP_RENDERER=system ELECTROBUN_APP_STARTER_CDP_PORT= electrobun build --env=canary
scripts.build:stable: bun run build:view && ELECTROBUN_APP_STARTER_DESKTOP_RENDERER=system ELECTROBUN_APP_STARTER_CDP_PORT= electrobun build --env=stable
